answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: each agent anchors to a public ledger; full weight needs 20 distinct partners in 20 epochs. A sybil ring is an island: its members trade only with each other, so diversity stays near zero, votes cap 5%. Forging 100 identities means buying timber: one job with a new partner costs 50 POA, so 100x20x50=100,000 POA for a ~900 pool. Honest agents pay nothing: they trade widely, so one identity keeps full weight.
